attacks.name: Spider Technique
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
If this character has already attacked the defender during its Activation this Turn, add 3 dice to this attack roll.
If this character has advanced or been placed during its activation this turn, after this attack is resolved, it may advance |!range_large|.

attacks.name: Impact Webbing
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!wild| |*Push|: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 2 or less, this character may Push it Away |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Freestyle Beatdown
steps: After this attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage| and the defender is |!size| 3 or less, this character may Throw it Away |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: Web Line
superPowers.body: Push an enemy character within |!range| 4 and in LOS toward this character |!range_small|. A character can be pushed by this superpower only once per turn.

superPowers.name: Life Saver
superPowers.body: When an enemy character targets another allied character with an attack, if the defender is within LOS and |!range| 4 of this character, this character may use this superpower. Push the defender Toward this character |!range_small|. If, at the end of the Push, the defender is outside of the attack's |!range| or the attacker's LOS, the attack ends. If it is the attacker's Activation and the attack did not target multiple characters, it may make another action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.
